transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
Hi, Dr. Smith. I feel drained all the time, like I never have the energy to get through work or even enjoy the things I used to. It just feels like I'm running on empty every single day.
How long have you been feeling this way, and would you say this low mood has been present for most days over the past two years?

Yes, it's definitely been present pretty much every day. Looking back, this heavy, drained feeling started around the middle of my second year of college, so it's been going on continuously for a little over two years now.
During these past two years, have there been any periods of a few weeks or more where your mood and energy felt significantly worse, almost like a separate, deeper episode of depression?
I haven't really noticed any distinct, deeper episodes like that. Instead, it has just been a continuous, steady level of heaviness and exhaustion throughout the entire two years.
During these past two years, have you experienced other symptoms like changes in your appetite, difficulty sleeping, or trouble concentrating?

I haven't really noticed any changes in my appetite or much trouble concentrating. And while I don't have trouble actually falling asleep, I just wake up feeling completely unrefreshed and exhausted no matter how many hours of sleep I get.
During these two years, have you frequently felt a sense of hopelessness or felt down on yourself regarding your abilities or worth?

Yes, I do. I constantly feel like a fraud who isn't as capable as my coworkers or classmates, and any setback just feels like proof that I don't belong. When I look ahead, all I see is an endless, exhausting grind with no real hope that things will ever get better.
During these past two years, have you ever experienced any periods of several days where you felt unusually energetic, talkative, or euphoric, even if it didn't last very long?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. My energy and mood have just been consistently low and drained, without any of those high periods or bursts of energy.
Besides the feelings of hopelessness and exhaustion you mentioned, have you also noticed any persistent feelings of low self-esteem or significant indecisiveness during these two years?

Yes, the self-doubt is really prominent, though indecisiveness isn't as much of an issue for me. I constantly compare myself to my coworkers and classmates, feeling like I'm not as smart or capable and that any mistake or mediocre grade is just proof that I'm a fraud who doesn't belong. It's a constant, heavy feeling of not being good enough.
